correctness.rationale: The source exact distance formula reduces with \(q=\lfloor n/s\rfloor\), \(r=n-qs\), and \(x=r/s\) to \(E^2=1-x(1-x)/(q+x)\). Using \(\alpha=\sqrt2-1\) and \(\alpha^2=1-2\alpha\) gives the displayed defect identity exactly. Nonattainment follows from irrationality; the iff stability statement follows from the positive \((q-1)\alpha^2\) term, with a uniform gap for \(q\ge2\). Continued-fraction convergents provide an infinite approaching sequence. The included symbolic checker replayed the identity and representative exact values.
